project_description: 첨부 영상의 프로젝트 중심 Site Audit 진입 경험을 SEMForge의 실제 크롤·PSI 데이터와 기존 상세 리포트 위에 구현한다.

features.name: 프로젝트 진단 현황 목록
features.description: 사이트 진단 기본 진입에서 모든 SEO 프로젝트의 설정·실행·완료 상태와 핵심 지표를 비교한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to compare all project audit statuses in one table, so that I can decide what needs attention first.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user opens /siteaudit/, when the page loads, then configured and unconfigured SEO projects in the same workspace are shown together.
Given a project has a completed run, when its row renders, then only persisted real metrics and explicit unavailable states are shown.
Given the viewport is 1904x947, when the list renders, then the header, toolbar, and metric table match the hierarchy observed in the reference video.

features.name: SEO 프로젝트 생성
features.description: 도메인과 선택적 이름으로 SEO 프로젝트를 만들고 Site Audit 설정으로 이어간다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to create a project from a domain, so that I can start auditing a new website.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid or unreachable public domain, when the user submits it, then the dialog shows a field-level reason and creates nothing.
Given a valid public domain and an empty name, when the user submits, then a normalized project is created with an automatically derived name.
Given another project uses the same domain, when validation completes, then an informational duplicate warning and existing-project path are shown before continuation.
Given a local, private, or reserved network target, when validation runs, then the server rejects it before making an outbound request.

features.name: 프로젝트 기반 진단 설정
features.description: 선택한 SEO 프로젝트에 범위, 페이지 한도, 소스, 일정, 완료 알림을 설정한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to configure crawl behavior before the first run, so that the audit reflects the intended scope and cost.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unconfigured project, when the user clicks setup, then the dialog is prefilled with that project's immutable domain context.
Given valid general settings, when the user saves, then exactly one active Site Audit campaign is linked to the project.
Given an advanced setting is not supported by the crawler backend, when the dialog renders, then the control is omitted or clearly unavailable and cannot be falsely saved.

features.name: 지속성 있는 비동기 진단 실행
features.description: 실행 요청을 큐에 저장하고 응답 이후 실제 Firecrawl 또는 자체 크롤러를 실행한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want the audit to continue after I leave or refresh the page, so that long crawls do not depend on an open browser request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid configured campaign, when the user starts an audit, then a queued run is persisted and the request returns without waiting for crawl completion.
Given a campaign already has a queued or running run, when another start is requested, then the server rejects the duplicate atomically.
Given the application process is interrupted, when the due runner executes, then recoverable queued or stale runs are resumed or failed with an explicit reason.
Given Firecrawl is available, when a run executes, then Firecrawl is attempted first and any fallback is recorded in provenance.

features.name: 실시간 행 진행 상태
features.description: 목록 행에서 준비, 실행, 완료, 실패 상태와 실제 수집 페이지 진행률을 표시한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to see real crawl progress in the project row, so that I know the audit is advancing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a queued run, when the list polls, then the row changes to a preparation state within two seconds.
Given pages are collected, when progress is persisted, then the row shows actual crawledPages/pageLimit rather than a timer-derived estimate.
Given no project is queued or running, when the list is idle, then background polling stops.
Given the user refreshes during a run, when the page reloads, then the same run state and last persisted progress are restored.

features.name: 실측 지표와 실행 대비 변화량
features.description: 최신 완료 실행의 진단 지표와 직전 완료 실행 대비 증감을 표시한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to compare current audit health with the previous run, so that I can verify whether fixes improved the site.
acceptance_criteria: Given two completed runs exist, when the row renders, then each comparable metric shows the mathematically correct latest-minus-previous delta.
Given only one run exists, when the row renders, then delta values are shown as unavailable rather than zero.
Given PageSpeed Insights is unavailable, when performance or Core Web Vitals renders, then it shows an unavailable state and a reason without fabricated data.
Given a value is shown, when its provenance is inspected, then the originating crawler or provider is identifiable.

features.name: 검색·정렬·페이지네이션
features.description: 프로젝트명/도메인 검색과 마지막 업데이트·이름 정렬, 서버 페이지네이션을 제공한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager with many projects, I want to search and sort the list, so that I can find a site quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search term, when the query is submitted, then only matching project names or domains from the current workspace are returned.
Given a supported sort is selected, when the list reloads, then deterministic server-side ordering is applied.
Given more rows than the selected page size, when pagination is used, then URL state and total counts remain correct.

features.name: 기존 상세 리포트 연결
features.description: 프로젝트 목록과 현재 상세 Site Audit 대시보드를 연결하고 기존 딥링크를 유지한다.
user_stories: As an SEO specialist, I want to open a project's detailed issues from the list, so that I can investigate and fix problems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed configured project, when the user clicks its name, then /siteaudit/?campaign=<id> opens the existing detailed report for that campaign.
Given an existing valid campaign deep link, when it is opened directly, then it continues to render the correct detailed report.
Given the user is in detail view, when the list back link is used, then /siteaudit/ opens without retaining an invalid campaign selection.

features.name: 오류·접근성·반응형 상태
features.description: 모든 주요 상태를 키보드와 보조기술로 사용할 수 있고 좁은 화면에서도 핵심 작업을 유지한다.
user_stories: As a keyboard or mobile user, I want all Site Audit flows to remain operable, so that I can complete the same tasks without a desktop mouse.
acceptance_criteria: Given a modal is open, when the user tabs or presses Escape, then focus is trapped, restored, or dismissed according to accessible dialog behavior.
Given a run state changes, when assistive technology is active, then a concise live-region update is announced.
Given a viewport narrower than the full metric table, when the list renders, then the project column remains available and horizontal scrolling or a summary layout exposes every metric.
Given a status uses color, when viewed without color distinction, then text or iconography still communicates the state.

features.name: 진단 완료 알림
features.description: 사용자가 선택한 경우 진단 완료 또는 실패를 인앱 알림과 구성된 이메일 채널로 전달한다.
user_stories: As an SEO manager, I want to be notified when a long audit finishes, so that I do not need to keep the page open.
acceptance_criteria: Given completion notifications are enabled, when a run reaches completed or failed, then one idempotent in-app notification is created.
Given no email provider is configured, when the user views the option, then email delivery is clearly unavailable rather than silently ignored.
Given the same run completion is processed twice, when notification delivery is retried, then the user receives no duplicate notification.

features.name: 고급 크롤 규칙
features.description: 크롤러, 허용/비허용 경로, URL 매개변수 규칙을 실제 수집 엔진에 적용한다.
user_stories: As a technical SEO specialist, I want to control crawl rules, so that large or parameterized sites are audited efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: Given include or exclude rules are saved, when a crawl runs, then out-of-rule URLs are not persisted as audited pages.
Given URL parameter rules are configured, when duplicate variants are discovered, then normalization follows the saved rule deterministically.
Given a rule is unsupported by the active engine, when the user saves settings, then the server rejects it with an actionable message.

features.name: AI 이슈 우선순위 요약
features.description: 실제 진단 결과를 바탕으로 영향도 높은 문제와 다음 조치를 설명하되 원본 이슈 근거를 함께 제시한다.
user_stories: As a non-technical site owner, I want a grounded summary of the most important audit issues, so that I know what to fix first.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AI provider is configured and a completed run exists, when a summary is requested, then every recommendation references persisted issue evidence from that run.
Given no AI provider is configured, when the detail page renders, then the core report remains fully usable without an AI placeholder.
Given the underlying run changes, when a new summary is generated, then it is versioned by run id and never presented as evidence for a different run.

fields.name: folderId
fields.constraints: required for new records, one active campaign per folder
